UpdateNotice.description:
A machine-readable fact in the shape of `Notice` in `schemas/v3/lint-report.schema.json`.

The schema allows only `x-` keys beyond `code`, `level` and `message`. The fields are in alphabetical order of their keys, the order the document has always printed them in.

x-migrate-hint.description: Set when the release is a new major version.

x-upgrade-command.description: The command that upgrades this install, when the channel is known.

description: The document that `slopvac --version --json` prints: the binary version and how it was installed, the `schema_version` numbers the binary reads or writes for each versioned artifact, the `slopvac_api` numbers it supports, and the update notice when a newer release is known. `slopvac self update` reads the same document from the installed executable, and ignores the members it does not know. Unknown keys are errors, and keys that start with `x-` are ignored. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/policies.md, section 3.2.

install_method.description: How this binary was installed, such as `installer`, `homebrew` or `unknown`.

notices.description: The update notice, when a newer release is known. Empty otherwise.

schema_version.description: The version of this document. A document written before the member existed reads as 3.

schema_versions.description: The `schema_version` numbers the binary reads or writes for each versioned artifact. A key is the schema file name without `.schema.json`.

slopvac_api.description: The extension API numbers the binary supports.

title: slopvac v3 version
